scope: max31855/riot: fixed task bus is spi. Contract is limited to RTOS/BSP headers, handles, called setup/transfer APIs, fixed controller binding and driver-level waits.

spi_acquire.signature: void spi_acquire(spi_t bus, spi_cs_t cs, spi_mode_t mode, spi_clk_t clk);

notes: Default RIOT SPI polling binding uses SPI_DEV(0) with spi_acquire/spi_release around each transfer.
RIOT chip-select handling is represented by spi_cs_t and can use hardware CS via SPI_HWCS(0) in the fixed experiment setup.
